title: Inventory below safety stock
recommended_action: Expedite replenishment and reserve remaining stock

title: Port congestion delay
recommended_action: Confirm revised ETA and assess alternate lane

title: Supplier short shipment
recommended_action: Allocate confirmed stock to priority orders

title: Temperature excursion
recommended_action: Place shipment on quality hold and request sensor log

title: Purchase order mismatch
recommended_action: Reconcile ASN and purchase order quantities

title: Reorder threshold approaching
recommended_action: Review reorder point during weekly planning

title: Supplier confirmation overdue
recommended_action: Request order acknowledgement and recovery date

title: Inbound delivery rescheduled
recommended_action: Update receiving capacity and notify planner

title: Cycle count discrepancy
recommended_action: Freeze affected bin and reconcile system quantity

title: Carrier scan missing
recommended_action: Request proof of pickup and refresh tracking

title: Supplier quality document missing
recommended_action: Hold receipt until quality documentation is approved
